stem:
Consider the following pairs : Peak Mountains
1. Namcha Barwa - Garhwal Himalaya
2. Nanda Devi - Kumaon Himalaya
3. Nokrek - Sikkim Himalaya
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
expl: Namcha Barwa mountain peak is located in Tibet (China). So it is not located in Garhwal Himalaya. There are two peaks named as Nanda Devi mountain peak - Nanda Devi West (7817 m) and Nanda Devi East (7434 m). Of these, Nanda Devi West is situated in Chamoli district, which is the peak of the Garhwal Himalaya Mountains, while Nanda Devi East located on the border of Chamoli, Pithoragarh and Bageshwar districts, which is the peak of the Kumaon Himalaya Mountains. Since only Nanda Devi Shikhar has been asked in the question, hence pair 2 is correctly matched. According to Sidney Burrard's regional division of the Himalayas, Nanda Devi is also a mountain peak of the Kumaon Himalayas. Nokrek peak is the highest peak of the Garo Hills (Meghalaya) range. It is not the peak of the Sikkim Himalayas.

stem: Which of the following is the highest mountain on Earth?
expl: Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world located in Nepal and China (Tibet). Its height is 8848m. Nepal and China jointly announced the new height of Mount Everest as 8848.86 meters. It is also known as “Sagarmatha” in Nepal.

stem: The first Indian woman to have climbed Mt. Everest is :
expl: Bachendri Pal is the first Indian woman to reach the summit of Mount Everest in 1984.

stem: The first woman to climb Mount Everest was :
expl: Junko Tabei (22 September, 1939-20 October, 2016) was a Japanese mountaineer. She was the first woman to climb Mount Everest on 16 May, 1975. She was also the first woman to climb the highest peaks of all the seven continents.

stem: The woman mountaineer who climbed Mt. Everest twice is :
expl: Santosh Yadav is the first woman in the world to climb Mount Everest twice. She first climbed the peak in May 1992 and then again in May 1993. She is also the second Indian woman to climb Mt. Everest. The first Indian woman was Bachendri Pal who succeeded in climbing the Everest in 1984.

stem:
Following are the mountain ranges of India
1. Garo Hills 2. Nandadevi
3. Kamet 4. K2
Which of the following is their correct sequence from east to west ?
expl: The correct east-to-west order of the mentioned mountain ranges is: Garo Hills, Nanda Devi, Kamet and K2. This correct answer is provided in option (d). The Garo Hills are located in the northeastern state of Meghalaya, Nanda Devi and Kamet are in Uttarakhand, and K2 (Godwin Austen) is in the Karakoram Range in the Union Territory of Ladakh.
